lines: "You'll be the one who went up the mine," a man says through the door. "It came round with the milk. We still don't open."
"We don't open after the bell, and not much before it," a man says. "No offence meant. Try the Arms, on the square."

lines.text: "You'll be the one who found Mr Ames his spectacles," a man says through the door. "It came round with the milk. We still don't open."
